description: Remix a public Sequenzy email gallery email into a new email template for this company. The new email keeps the example's exact layout and design; AI rewrites every piece of text for the company and its logo, brand color and links are swapped in. The example brand is never named and none of its copy, offers or claims are reused. Saved as an HTML template. Requires templates:write. Takes 5-20 seconds. Creates no template if generation fails (a company's first AI generation still saves its inferred email design direction); each successful call creates another template. Accepts a gallery email URL (https://sequenzy.com/email-examples/brands/{brand}/emails/{email}, or for an email in a sequence the sequence page URL ending in #email-{email}) or brand plus email slugs. For a whole sequence use create_sequence_from_example.

brand.description: Gallery brand slug from the URL (/email-examples/brands/{brand}/...). Use with the example slug instead of url.

brief.description: Optional direction, up to 1000 characters, such as an offer or feature to highlight. Takes priority over the example.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Gallery email slug from the URL (/emails/{email}). Use with brand instead of url.

name.description: Optional name, up to 200 characters, for what is created.

url.description: Email gallery page URL. Provide either url, or brand plus the example slug; not both.

name: create_template_from_example

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_template_from_example` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

example.description: The gallery example it was modeled on: brand, subject and url.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: What was created and what to check.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

template.description: The email template record returned by Sequenzy.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
